title: Learning Gait-Aware Quadruped Locomotion with Temporal Logic Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2607.00442v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for quadruped locomotion commonly depends on fixed, hand-crafted, and Markovian reward functions that may limit interpretability of learned policies and may lack explicit control over gait behaviors. We introduce a framework where distinct gaits are specified using parameterized constraints expressed in Signal Temporal Logic (STL). These include safety bounds, gait synchronization constraints, command tracking, and actuation bounds. From these specifications, we develop a reward shaping mechanism that provides learning agents a dense, continuous reward landscape that encodes desired behavior. We define parametric STL templates for three speed regimes (walking-trot, trot, bound), calibrate their parameters from reference rollouts, and compute rewards from using smooth approximations of STL robustness over the rollouts. The generated rewards can be used to provide shaped gradients compatible with Proxi

translated_title: 基于时序逻辑规范的学习步态感知四足机器人运动
translated_abstract: 四足机器人运动的强化学习（RL）通常依赖于固定的、手工设计的马尔可夫奖励函数，这可能限制所学策略的可解释性，并且缺乏对步态行为的显式控制。我们引入了一个框架，其中不同的步态通过用信号时序逻辑（STL）表达的参数化约束来指定。这些约束包括安全边界、步态同步约束、指令跟踪和执行器边界。基于这些规范，我们开发了一种奖励塑形机制，为学习智能体提供一个编码了期望行为的密集、连续的奖励景观。我们为三种速度模式（行走-快步、快步、跳跃）定义了参数化STL模板，从参考轨迹中校准其参数，并通过对轨迹上STL鲁棒性的平滑近似来计算奖励。生成的奖励可用于提供与近端策略优化兼容的塑形梯度。
tldr: 该论文提出用信号时序逻辑（STL）参数化规范来定义四足机器人的步态约束并自动生成密集奖励，实现了对步态行为的显式控制、更好的可解释性以及与强化学习的无缝兼容。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using parameterized Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications to define quadruped gait constraints and automatically generate dense rewards, enabling explicit control over gait behaviors, improved interpretability, and seamless compatibility with reinforcement learning.
